scope: Source availability and acquisition only; no computed returns, event outcomes, estimates or FTN tests
population: 57 workbook January/July candidate records, 8 dates 2003–2006; not yet certified scheduled events
normalization: Remove literal trailing (expired), preserve full historic RIC expiry suffix; no substitute RIC
interval: For each RIC earliest candidate ED minus400 calendar days through latest ED plus200 calendar days. Supplement requests clipped at2006-12-31; existing data may supply2007 tail. Index common span follows same bound.
reuse: Existing exact-RIC panel observations retained in separate reusable extract. New data never overwrite source files or silently replace nonmissing old values.
fields: Stock TR.PriceClose,TR.TotalReturn,TR.TotalReturn1D,TR.Volume,TR.CompanyMarketCap,TR.SharesOutstanding; historical BID/ASK separate only if supported within90-request budget. Benchmark .OMXSBGI/.OMXSGI close levels, no converting returns into prices.
normalization_gate: Record exact returned headers/source field mapping. TR.TotalReturn and TR.TotalReturn1D distinct raw columns; choose explicit1D for normalized totret if present, label percent return not index. No silent derivation/fill.
private_output: All raw and normalized numeric price histories restricted to private/. Public output limited code, source metadata and aggregate coverage.
